newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles County OKs Marina del Rey plan - report.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles County OKs Marina del Rey plan - report.

text.p: The Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors has adopted a redevelopment plan for Marina del Rey that will require competitive bidding for new leases, the Los Angeles Times reported Wednesday.

County supervisors voted unanimously at their meeting Tuesday to direct the Department of Beaches and Harbors to solicit "open, competitive bids on any leases made available" at the man-made harbor, the Times reported.
The marina's apartments, hotels, boat slips and offices were built on county land in the 1960s by a small group of developers and have been operated on long-term leases.
Going forward, the county will require detailed land and water value appraisals in the marina before granting lease extensions or any new leases, the Times reported.
